0176957aef10.en: “Thanks—” Standing up, he crossed eyes with the large black bird chilling by the other seat, apparently looking at him with a “Yo!—got any more grub?” dead stare and a shuffling head. Ignoring the bird, he made himself out of the room, and saw a large rectangle with stairs going down in the middle, and two walkways on both sides that lead across the open concept room. Scratching his neck beard, Harry stood there, pausing for a second, looking towards the doors on the other side, or the stairs in front of him. If Eiri is not helping me, then who will?—why did she help me in the first place?
0176957aef10.t: “Terima kasih—” Berdiri, matanya bertemu dengan burung hitam besar yang bersantai di dekat kursi lain, tampaknya memandangnya dengan tatapan mati “Yo!—masih ada makanan?” dan kepala yang bergoyang-goyang. Mengabaikan burung itu, ia keluar dari ruangan, dan melihat sebuah persegi panjang besar dengan tangga turun di tengahnya, dan dua lorong di kedua sisi yang mengarah melintasi ruangan berkonsep terbuka itu. Menggaruk janggut lehernya, Harry berdiri di sana, terdiam sejenak, memandang ke arah pintu-pintu di sisi lain, atau tangga di depannya. Kalau Eiri tidak membantuku, lalu siapa?—kenapa dia membantuku dari awal?

01dd91055dd1.en: “Not really—I mean, I tried to, but there are so many words I don’t know.” Harry made a culpable smile, his tone growing distant. “I thought you would help me.”
01dd91055dd1.t: “Tidak juga—maksudku, aku sudah mencoba, tapi ada banyak sekali kata yang tidak kutahu.” Harry tersenyum bersalah, nadanya menjauh. “Kukira kamu akan membantuku.”

01ef7d22d653.en: With his eyes widened, Harry saw her bending over, just enough to show a hint of exposed private skin. Harry squinted his eyes as hard as he could, trying to sharpen his vision even if just a smidge.
01ef7d22d653.t: Dengan mata terbelalak, Harry melihatnya membungkuk, cukup untuk memperlihatkan sedikit kulit pribadi yang terbuka. Harry menyipitkan matanya sekuat mungkin, mencoba mempertajam penglihatannya meski hanya sedikit.

0600c2efcd19.en: Harry opened his eyes again as he saw the stranger in gray hair walk past, ignoring Sora. He then saw Maiara, his future would-be wife, proudly smile at Neferteri with rakuja juice running down her cheeks like she was a happy pig after feeding from a trough. He looked down to his lap, and picked up the wet dirty towel resting on it to once again clean himself.
0600c2efcd19.t: Harry membuka matanya lagi saat ia melihat orang asing berambut abu-abu itu lewat, mengabaikan Sora. Ia lalu melihat Maiara, calon istrinya, tersenyum bangga kepada Neferteri dengan sari rakuja mengalir di pipinya seperti babi yang bahagia setelah makan dari palung. Ia menunduk ke pangkuannya, dan mengambil handuk basah kotor yang terletak di sana untuk sekali lagi membersihkan dirinya.

06e2d4a31982.en: Walking further along, Harry noticed a large puke, and a black hair piece near it, coincidently about the size of Sora’s. What am I even doing at this point? Ignoring the nausea from the smell of the puke mixed with alcohol, he walked away from the lamps, into a darker part of the courtyard. Looking at the stars above, he saw them as hazy and out of focus points of familiar lights in a blanket of dark greenish hues. Somehow the freckles of light, and how they were spread throughout the sky felt normal, but the color of the night did not. Next, he looked at the lone moon, now higher in the horizon, shining a constant green bright green hue, as if protected by a shimmering veil. That doesn’t feel right—
06e2d4a31982.t: Berjalan lebih jauh, Harry melihat muntahan besar, dan sepotong rambut hitam di dekatnya, kebetulan kira-kira seukuran milik Sora. Sebenarnya aku sedang apa sih? Mengabaikan mual dari bau muntahan bercampur alkohol, ia berjalan menjauh dari lampu-lampu, ke bagian halaman yang lebih gelap. Memandang bintang-bintang di atas, ia melihatnya sebagai titik-titik cahaya familier yang kabur dan tidak fokus di tengah selimut warna kehijauan yang gelap. Entah bagaimana bintik-bintik cahaya itu, dan bagaimana mereka tersebar di langit, terasa normal, tetapi warna malamnya tidak. Berikutnya, ia memandang bulan yang sendirian, kini lebih tinggi di cakrawala, memancarkan warna hijau terang yang konstan, seolah dilindungi selubung yang berkilauan. Itu terasa tidak benar—

0981ebd50acd.en: “Eiri told you everything?” Harry looked at the muddy tea in his cup, imagining Eiri giving her pinky promise to him. Did she already break it?
0981ebd50acd.t: “Eiri menceritakan semuanya kepadamu?” Harry memandang teh berlumpur di cangkirnya, membayangkan Eiri memberikan janji kelingkingnya kepadanya. Apa dia sudah melanggarnya?

0a4be2a8bb9e.en: Sitting by her, Harry’s tightened clothes were again nearly exploding at the seams. His hairy gut was poking through the stretched fabric, including his belly button which shone through one of the holes—truly what a girl of cultured taste would consider a true panty-dropping sex appeal. Harry could not speak simply because the words weren’t coming up in his hectic brain. He felt his heart steadily grow faster, and his breathing erratic.
0a4be2a8bb9e.t: Duduk di sampingnya, pakaian Harry yang ketat lagi-lagi nyaris meledak di jahitannya. Perutnya yang berbulu menyembul dari kain yang meregang, termasuk pusarnya yang terlihat dari salah satu celah—benar-benar apa yang akan dianggap gadis berselera tinggi sebagai daya tarik seks yang bikin celana dalam melorot. Harry tidak bisa bicara hanya karena kata-katanya tidak muncul di otaknya yang kalang kabut. Ia merasakan jantungnya terus berdetak semakin cepat, dan napasnya tak beraturan.

0a94a4a3fe35.en: The moisty warmth of the towel on his face felt like salvation. Harry’s reddened eyes were able to see something again, albeit they still burned, just like when you cut onions. He saw Eiri wrinkling her brow, worriedly looking back at him, while the rest of the table continually drank and ate. Amongst the voices, he heard Itagiba’s voice saying something along the lines of Gabiro fucking it up across the table to the girl in purple, and a guy in gray hair and horizontal-striped blue and gold clothing saying something back.
0a94a4a3fe35.t: Kehangatan lembap handuk di wajahnya terasa seperti keselamatan. Mata Harry yang memerah bisa melihat sesuatu lagi, meski masih perih, seperti saat memotong bawang. Ia melihat Eiri mengerutkan dahi, memandangnya kembali dengan cemas, sementara orang-orang lain di meja terus minum dan makan. Di antara suara-suara itu, ia mendengar suara Itagiba mengatakan sesuatu semacam Gabiro mengacaukan semuanya di seberang meja kepada gadis berbaju ungu, dan seorang pria berambut abu-abu dengan pakaian bergaris horizontal biru dan emas membalas sesuatu.

0ac946e5f76b.en: The maid’s face grew closer, wetting her lips. “Is that so?” Her voice shifted into stinging again. “So did you also forget that you need to ask people their name?”
0ac946e5f76b.t: Wajah pelayan itu semakin dekat, membasahi bibirnya. “Begitu ya?” Suaranya berubah menyengat lagi. “Jadi kau juga lupa bahwa kau harus menanyakan nama orang?”

0b77ed29ad17.en: “Princess Eori—” Neferteri slowly glanced at her, sipping her wine.
0b77ed29ad17.t: “Putri Eori—” Neferteri perlahan meliriknya, sambil menyesap anggurnya.

0ee2fe41f2cc.en: I wonder where Maiara is right now? They haven’t said anything about her yet. Avoiding making too much eye contact with the people at the table, he directed his attention towards the strange metal flatware he was holding, playing close attention to its odd shape, a two-prong fork on one end, and a spoon on the other with wavy carvings in the middle that spelled out two words: Donas’ Picker? Oh! So that’s what a picker is! Harry remembered seeing that mentioned somewhere in one of the books he had glanced at. So it really is like a fork and spoon combined!
0ee2fe41f2cc.t: Aku penasaran Maiara ada di mana sekarang? Mereka belum mengatakan apa pun tentangnya. Menghindari terlalu banyak kontak mata dengan orang-orang di meja, ia mengalihkan perhatiannya ke alat makan logam aneh yang ia pegang, dengan saksama memperhatikan bentuknya yang aneh, garpu bercabang dua di satu ujung, dan sendok di ujung lain dengan ukiran bergelombang di tengahnya yang membentuk dua kata: Donas’ Picker? Oh! Jadi itu yang namanya picker! Harry teringat pernah melihatnya disebut di salah satu buku yang sempat ia lirik. Jadi memang seperti garpu dan sendok yang digabung!

0f731b331d06.en: Eiri bit her lips, speaking from what appeared to be a canned response. “Because we trust the kingdom, rather than an individual from tampering with the contract. So—you really didn’t read it?” Her eyes shone with a motherly look as she clenched her gloved hands.
0f731b331d06.t: Eiri menggigit bibirnya, berbicara dengan apa yang tampak seperti jawaban hafalan. “Karena kami memercayai kerajaan, bukan perorangan, untuk tidak mengutak-atik kontrak. Jadi—kamu benar-benar tidak membacanya?” Matanya bersinar dengan tatapan keibuan sambil mengepalkan tangannya yang bersarung.

0fb16c14d5a5.en: Eori’s cheek was red like a tomato, and she started to swallow. “Fucking bitch!” Eori forcefully took the towel from Sora’s hand, who rushed to her aid, and began cleaning after herself, including the blood slowly surging from within the side of her lips.
0fb16c14d5a5.t: Pipi Eori merah seperti tomat, dan ia mulai menelan ludah. “Jalang sialan!” Eori dengan paksa merebut handuk dari tangan Sora, yang bergegas menolongnya, dan mulai membersihkan dirinya sendiri, termasuk darah yang perlahan merembes dari sisi dalam bibirnya.

0fec75b57d76.en: “She didn't say?” Harry promptly replied, holding his diabetic-inducing citrusy tea.
0fec75b57d76.t: “Dia tidak bilang?” jawab Harry segera, memegang teh jeruknya yang bikin diabetes.

0ffc3fcf6c29.en: Arukia took another sip of her muddy tea, enjoying its somehow delectable flavors when a knock in the door interrupted their moment of Zen.
0ffc3fcf6c29.t: Arukia menyesap lagi teh berlumpurnya, menikmati rasanya yang entah bagaimana lezat ketika ketukan di pintu menginterupsi momen Zen mereka.

1009041e76ca.en: “What did you like the most?” Itagiba caught Harry’s attention.
1009041e76ca.t: “Apa yang paling kau suka?” Itagiba menarik perhatian Harry.

1229a000bda7.en: Noticing the maid making herself at home, Harry was still at the door, quite motionless, while his brain kept on processing the pantyless-ness of her situation. His mouth semi-opened, he vaguely stared at the maid, interlocking her fingers through her beautifully smooth dark brown hair, and sending them away from her face, all while perusing the book Harry was previously trying to read. Her crossed legs brought attention to her foot, slowly, but rhythmically kicking the air, but the longer Harry watched them dance around, the more intense its rhythm became.
1229a000bda7.t: Melihat pelayan itu bersikap seperti di rumah sendiri, Harry masih di pintu, cukup tak bergerak, sementara otaknya terus memproses ketiadaan celana dalam pelayan itu. Dengan mulut setengah terbuka, ia menatap kosong pelayan itu, yang menyisipkan jari-jarinya ke rambut cokelat gelapnya yang indah dan halus, dan menyibakkannya dari wajahnya, sambil membaca-baca buku yang tadi coba dibaca Harry. Kakinya yang bersilang menarik perhatian ke telapak kakinya, yang perlahan, tetapi berirama, menendang-nendang udara, tetapi semakin lama Harry memperhatikannya menari, semakin cepat iramanya.

12d525ec0540.en: “We talked about this. Dear!—please go to bed.” Neferteri placed her hand on his shoulder, and squeezed tightly.
12d525ec0540.t: “Kita sudah membicarakan ini. Sayang!—tolong pergi tidur.” Neferteri meletakkan tangannya di bahunya, dan meremasnya kuat-kuat.

12e16498575d.en: “Sora, did you use my mother’s recipe on the Bagarisa?” Eiri glanced towards Sora.
12e16498575d.t: “Sora, apa kamu memakai resep ibuku untuk Bagarisa-nya?” Eiri melirik ke arah Sora.

13d4f9006a3f.en: “Yes, my queen.” The tall maid at the door turned back towards the queen to excuse herself again.
13d4f9006a3f.t: “Baik, ratuku.” Pelayan jangkung di pintu berbalik ke arah sang ratu untuk pamit lagi.

13e1a92b9125.en: Harry did not feel much of the ball-shaped mark left on his forehead, for his eyes started burning as if he had spilled lime juice on it. He dropped his picker, and wiped away the juice and seeds with his hands, but the viscous and sticky nature of it prevented him from making any meaningful progress. Rather, he was mostly spreading the juice around his face.
13e1a92b9125.t: Harry tidak terlalu merasakan bekas berbentuk bola yang tertinggal di dahinya, karena matanya mulai perih seolah ia menumpahkan air jeruk nipis ke sana. Ia menjatuhkan picker-nya, dan menyeka sari buah dan biji-biji itu dengan tangannya, tetapi sifatnya yang kental dan lengket membuatnya tidak bisa membuat kemajuan berarti. Sebaliknya, ia malah lebih banyak meratakan sari buah itu ke seluruh wajahnya.

14dec8b233bb.en: “I’m not sure exactly. Like slightly earthy, comes in a blue thing wrapped in plastic wrap? Yeah! Kinda whitish, but I can’t quite remember the shape of the mushroom inside.” Harry saw himself picking up a blue box from a supermarket shelf, knowing it was mushrooms, but didn’t know its shape.
14dec8b233bb.t: “Aku tidak yakin persisnya. Rasanya agak seperti tanah, dijual dalam wadah biru yang dibungkus plastik? Iya! Agak keputihan, tapi aku tidak ingat betul bentuk jamur di dalamnya.” Harry melihat dirinya mengambil sebuah kotak biru dari rak supermarket, tahu bahwa itu jamur, tetapi tidak tahu bentuknya.

1500f84055ac.en: Eiri’s head slowly turned side to side, trying to remain serious, but soon after a chuckle surfaced, breaking her tension. “Take him to his room, please!” She spoke loudly.
1500f84055ac.t: Kepala Eiri perlahan menggeleng, berusaha tetap serius, tetapi tak lama kemudian kekehan muncul, memecah ketegangannya. “Bawa dia ke kamarnya, tolong!” katanya keras-keras.

172c552b1b52.en: Harry made his way back to his room—well, as much as it was “his” room as someone going back to “his” hostel bed after spending the day walking about in a foreign country. It might feel like a home, relatively speaking, but for sure it isn’t.
172c552b1b52.t: Harry kembali ke kamarnya—yah, sejauh kamar itu “kamarnya” seperti seseorang yang kembali ke ranjang hostel “miliknya” setelah seharian berjalan-jalan di negeri asing. Mungkin terasa seperti rumah, relatif saja, tetapi jelas bukan rumah.

1a1ef056144e.en: Neferteri keenly observed his puppy eyes towards Eiri. “Would you like us to give you a summary of it, or would you rather read for yourself?”
1a1ef056144e.t: Neferteri dengan saksama mengamati mata memelasnya ke arah Eiri. “Apakah Anda ingin kami memberikan ringkasannya, atau Anda lebih suka membacanya sendiri?”

1ab7b50c845c.en: “Awww—fuck!” The sounds of someone tumbling down the stairs followed by a splat on the floor echoed from outside the room. “—ahhhhhh—my back—I’m fine! I’m fine!—ow—my back.” Itagiba’s not-as-strong-willed voice echoed from afar.
1ab7b50c845c.t: “Aduuuh—bangsat!” Suara seseorang yang jatuh berguling di tangga disusul bunyi gedebuk di lantai menggema dari luar ruangan. “—ahhhhhh—punggungku—aku baik-baik saja! Aku baik-baik saja!—aduh—punggungku.” Suara Itagiba yang tak lagi sekuat tadi menggema dari kejauhan.

1bb87049f1df.en: Lifting the rakuja above her head, right above her open wide mouth, Maiara squeezed the life out of it. Her forearm and hand muscles contracted hard enough to make the rakuja explode everywhere.
1bb87049f1df.t: Mengangkat rakuja itu di atas kepalanya, tepat di atas mulutnya yang terbuka lebar, Maiara meremasnya habis-habisan. Otot lengan bawah dan tangannya berkontraksi cukup kuat untuk membuat rakuja itu meledak ke mana-mana.

1bfb582dc630.en: Harry looked at Eiri, who looked right back at him with a flat smile, and a stalled rigid posture. Feeling like the time had come, he dry gulped. “I—yes, please.”
1bfb582dc630.t: Harry memandang Eiri, yang balas memandangnya dengan senyum datar, dan postur kaku yang tertahan. Merasa saatnya telah tiba, ia menelan ludah kering. “Aku—iya, tolong.”

1dd83fe58138.en: Eiri grabbed Neferteri’s badge, and gave it back. Rolling up the contract, she asked one thing—insinuating more of a demand than question. “When will you give him the opportunity to read?”
1dd83fe58138.t: Eiri mengambil lencana Neferteri, dan mengembalikannya. Menggulung kontrak itu, ia menanyakan satu hal—lebih menyiratkan tuntutan daripada pertanyaan. “Kapan Anda akan memberinya kesempatan untuk membaca?”

22e187074190.en: “S—sorry” Fumbling through his delivery, Harry stepped aside, giving way to her as he scratched his head—the shit eating grin on him proved he was sorry, but not that sorry.
22e187074190.t: “M—maaf” Terbata-bata, Harry menyingkir, memberinya jalan sambil menggaruk kepalanya—seringai cengengesannya membuktikan ia memang menyesal, tetapi tidak terlalu menyesal.

24a02327cd12.en: Harry quickly, but firmly shook his head. “I saw the three sisters in the book, but it did not feel familiar at all.”
24a02327cd12.t: Harry dengan cepat, tetapi tegas, menggeleng. “Aku sudah lihat tiga saudari itu di buku, tapi sama sekali tidak terasa familier.”

2a146f387e5b.en: Nina, feeling Maiara’s intention, stood up, and bent over the table, protecting her rakujas with her hands like a chicken protecting its chicklings from the rain. However, it was to no avail as Maiara’s hands firmly reached towards her rakujas. “NO! MAIARA! NO!” Nina struggled with all her might, making loud, yet cute grunts against Maiara’s sticky wet hands, trying to reach for one of the tennis-ball-sized rakujas. “NO! LEAVE THEM ALONE!” As the struggle kept going, Nina saw one last way to defend her precious children, and jabbed the fork side of a picker deep into Maiara’s arm.
2a146f387e5b.t: Nina, merasakan niat Maiara, berdiri, dan membungkuk di atas meja, melindungi rakuja-rakujanya dengan tangannya seperti induk ayam yang melindungi anak-anaknya dari hujan. Namun, sia-sia saja karena tangan Maiara dengan mantap meraih rakuja-rakujanya. “JANGAN! MAIARA! JANGAN!” Nina berjuang sekuat tenaga, mengeluarkan erangan keras, namun imut, melawan tangan Maiara yang lengket dan basah, yang berusaha meraih salah satu rakuja seukuran bola tenis itu. “JANGAN! JANGAN GANGGU MEREKA!” Saat perebutan terus berlangsung, Nina melihat satu cara terakhir untuk membela anak-anaknya yang berharga, dan menusukkan sisi garpu picker dalam-dalam ke lengan Maiara.

2c131abc7382.en: With a teasing laugh, the maid pushed Harry away. “Sora—you dummy!” She leaned forward, and poured the hot blackish tea into the two white porcelain cups she had brought. The tea itself had a rather thick, sandy sloppy consistency to it, just like the bottom of a muddy river. The steam coming out had a strong tangy, citrusy fragrance with sweet grass notes—not far from resembling an air refresher. She served a cup to Harry, then grabbed another one for herself, leaning back on the couch.
2c131abc7382.t: Dengan tawa menggoda, pelayan itu mendorong Harry menjauh. “Sora—dasar bodoh!” Ia mencondongkan tubuh ke depan, dan menuangkan teh panas kehitaman ke dalam dua cangkir porselen putih yang ia bawa. Teh itu sendiri kekentalannya cukup pekat, berpasir dan lembek, persis seperti dasar sungai berlumpur. Uap yang keluar beraroma asam dan jeruk yang kuat dengan nuansa rumput manis—tidak jauh dari mirip pengharum ruangan. Ia menyajikan satu cangkir untuk Harry, lalu mengambil satu lagi untuk dirinya sendiri, bersandar di sofa.

2c1a2688aec3.en: The maid tapped her finger on the map, showing a bird’s-eye view of an inland harbor region with a large, roundish estuary in the middle where a sprawling city surrounded the inland-most part of the estuary. From those spread-out outports, large roads from near the ends headed inland, all merging in a triangle shape far inland. From that inland triangle vertice, an even larger road arose from the edge of the city, and went off the map to the west. She tapped her fingers at the eastern section of the city, near the east vertice of the triangle, close to the ports, where a small road randomly went to the right. “Are you from the Sanbi East slum?”
2c1a2688aec3.t: Pelayan itu mengetuk-ngetukkan jarinya di peta, yang menunjukkan pemandangan dari atas sebuah wilayah pelabuhan pedalaman dengan muara besar yang agak bundar di tengahnya, di mana sebuah kota yang membentang mengelilingi bagian muara yang paling dalam. Dari pelabuhan-pelabuhan luar yang tersebar itu, jalan-jalan besar dari dekat ujung-ujungnya mengarah ke pedalaman, semuanya menyatu membentuk segitiga jauh di pedalaman. Dari titik sudut segitiga pedalaman itu, jalan yang lebih besar lagi muncul dari tepi kota, dan keluar dari peta ke arah barat. Ia mengetukkan jarinya di bagian timur kota, dekat titik sudut timur segitiga itu, dekat pelabuhan, di mana sebuah jalan kecil berbelok acak ke kanan. “Kau dari permukiman kumuh Sanbi Timur?”

2c4d1bd0711c.en: “I—I—don’t know. Everything feels murky—I looked through a few books, but none of the drawings feels familiar!” Harry slouched his posture, his drooly eyes looked as if had finally given up.
2c4d1bd0711c.t: “A—aku—tidak tahu. Semuanya terasa keruh—aku sudah melihat-lihat beberapa buku, tapi tidak ada gambar yang terasa familier!” Harry membungkukkan tubuhnya, matanya yang sayu tampak seolah akhirnya menyerah.

2c9958c702f2.en: “—still not as good as Yacamim!” A mischievous low voice came from the princess in purple, Eori, as she slowly took another bite of her food, appearing to imitate Neferteri’s grace, but somehow looking more forced than natural. Normally the voice would go unheard, but the momentary silence in the room allowed it to propagate further than normal.
2c9958c702f2.t: “—masih tidak sebagus Yacamim!” Suara pelan yang nakal datang dari sang putri berambut ungu, Eori, saat ia perlahan menggigit lagi makanannya, tampak meniru keanggunan Neferteri, tetapi entah bagaimana terlihat lebih dipaksakan daripada alami. Biasanya suara itu tidak akan terdengar, tetapi keheningan sesaat di ruangan itu membuatnya merambat lebih jauh dari biasanya.

2ed734a739ff.en: “I’m aware of your actions, please cease them.” Neferteri placed her wine glass on the table, and looked at Eori, enjoying herself with a large smirk from ear to ear despite her red swollen cheek, and still cleaning away rakuja seeds from her long purple hair.
2ed734a739ff.t: “Saya tahu apa yang kamu lakukan, tolong hentikan.” Neferteri meletakkan gelas anggurnya di meja, dan memandang Eori, yang sedang menikmati dirinya dengan seringai lebar dari telinga ke telinga meskipun pipinya merah bengkak, dan masih membersihkan biji-biji rakuja dari rambut ungu panjangnya.

2f1cc8ac9d72.en: “Really? Then if you don’t mind my curiosity—how do you know what an hour is?” Arukia pressed her boobs further against Harry as she came closer.
2f1cc8ac9d72.t: “Benarkah? Kalau begitu, kalau kau tidak keberatan aku penasaran—bagaimana kau tahu jam itu apa?” Arukia makin menekankan dadanya ke Harry sambil mendekat.

302ba0e4a485.en: “You two are paying for her rakujas,” Itagiba’s fatherly, but iron-strong willed voice sliced through Nina’s cries towards both princesses, pointing at them with a half-eaten purple meat thigh as if it was his gavel.
302ba0e4a485.t: “Kalian berdua yang bayar rakuja-nya,” suara Itagiba yang kebapakan, tetapi berkemauan sekeras baja, mengiris tangisan Nina ke arah kedua putri itu, menunjuk mereka dengan paha daging ungu yang setengah dimakan seolah itu palu hakimnya.

338589b1f56d.en: Meanwhile, with a quick gulp to clear his throat, Harry pointed at the closed door where his eyes saw someone familiar. “I think it was her! The maid that gave me tea earlier in the day.”
338589b1f56d.t: Sementara itu, dengan tegukan cepat untuk membersihkan tenggorokannya, Harry menunjuk pintu yang tertutup tempat matanya melihat seseorang yang familier. “Kurasa itu dia! Pelayan yang memberiku teh tadi siang.”

354a9090763d.en: Taking a long, slow sip of her muddy tea, Arukia’s cyan eyes narrowed towards Harry, taking umbrage as she watched his hesitancy to drink. Shuffling her hair like she didn’t care, Arukia followed up, “Maybe it was unrelated—anyway, now drink it up!”
354a9090763d.t: Menyesap teh berlumpurnya panjang dan perlahan, mata sian Arukia menyipit ke arah Harry, tersinggung melihat keraguannya untuk minum. Mengibaskan rambutnya seolah tidak peduli, Arukia melanjutkan, “Mungkin tidak ada hubungannya—pokoknya, sekarang habiskan!”

354fedb55edb.en: Harry, glancing through the contract, saw many unrecognizable words with what appeared to be a flowery language. Some words popped out like Gandew Common Duel Rights & Duties and Forway Duel “I—guess so—can you summarize it, please?”
354fedb55edb.t: Harry, melirik isi kontrak itu, melihat banyak kata yang tidak ia kenali dengan bahasa yang tampaknya berbunga-bunga. Beberapa kata menonjol, seperti Gandew Common Duel Rights & Duties dan Forway Duel. “Aku—kurasa begitu—bisa tolong diringkas?”

357c9df48ec6.en: With a repressed groan, Harry felt repulsed from seeing how much tea was left—like a child seeing he still needs to eat all his veggies. “Hmmm—but another maid brought tea already. Do I have to drink more?”
357c9df48ec6.t: Dengan erangan tertahan, Harry merasa jijik melihat betapa banyak teh yang tersisa—seperti anak kecil yang melihat ia masih harus menghabiskan semua sayurnya. “Hmmm—tapi pelayan lain sudah membawakan teh. Apa aku harus minum lagi?”

370ec4a519b3.en: Sora was waking the big black bird up, calling it towards the table. “Y–yes! King-maid! Salted Bagarisa, marinated for half timehunk in butter, salt, nica pepper, and Yabuca juice, slow cooked for two timehunks, then flash fried at the end.” The cutesy small maid, blushing as always, flawlessly recited the recipe as she brought a plate closer for the bird to peck at.
370ec4a519b3.t: Sora sedang membangunkan burung hitam besar itu, memanggilnya ke arah meja. “B–benar! King-maid! Bagarisa asin, dimarinasi selama setengah timehunk dalam mentega, garam, merica nica, dan sari Yabuca, dimasak perlahan selama dua timehunk, lalu digoreng cepat di akhir.” Pelayan mungil yang imut itu, merona seperti biasa, melafalkan resep itu dengan sempurna sambil mendekatkan sebuah piring agar burung itu bisa mematuk.

375800e81fb1.en: “This is too fishy! Next time I will make it myself with gyut and bacon!” Arukia handed over the mostly intact bagel to Harry.
375800e81fb1.t: “Ini terlalu amis! Lain kali aku buat sendiri pakai gyut dan bacon!” Arukia menyerahkan bagel yang hampir utuh kepada Harry.

38ef854c4b7d.en: “MOOOOM! My rakuja—” Nina’s voice cracked, and tears poured again from her eyes. She stood there in her seat, as if she had lost her babies.
38ef854c4b7d.t: “MAMAAAA! Rakujaku—” Suara Nina pecah, dan air mata kembali tumpah dari matanya. Ia berdiri di kursinya, seolah baru kehilangan bayi-bayinya.

395090e71198.en: With a long-winded sigh, Harry walked back towards the southeast tower. Am I doing the right thing? Maybe I should have signed it already. I mean, after all, they gave me everything I have right now. But then why did Eiri say all of that? How can I even think carefully when I know jack shit?
395090e71198.t: Dengan helaan napas panjang, Harry berjalan kembali menuju southeast tower. Apa aku melakukan hal yang benar? Mungkin seharusnya aku sudah menandatanganinya. Maksudku, bagaimanapun juga, mereka yang memberiku semua yang kumiliki sekarang. Tapi kenapa Eiri mengatakan semua itu? Bagaimana aku bisa berpikir baik-baik kalau aku tidak tahu apa-apa?

3a079d059f53.en: Itagiba pointed to a half-eaten purple thigh towards Eori “True dat, but you poked her first, so that’s why you’re paying back half of what she gave to Nina.”
3a079d059f53.t: Itagiba menunjuk Eori dengan paha ungu yang setengah dimakan, “Benar juga, tapi kau yang memancingnya duluan, makanya kau membayar kembali setengah dari yang dia berikan ke Nina.”

3a407e5425b1.en: “Itanema, can you go with her?” Eiri looked at the tall maid, just chilling, waiting for instructions as she didn’t seem to care whatever was happening.
3a407e5425b1.t: “Itanema, bisa kamu ikut dengannya?” Eiri memandang pelayan jangkung itu, yang sedang bersantai saja, menunggu instruksi karena ia tampaknya tidak peduli apa pun yang sedang terjadi.

3addbb915aea.en: Chapter IV subchapter 1: a brown-haired woman in a dark corset dress holding a teapot, smirking in a dim stairwell.
3addbb915aea.t: Bab IV subbab 1: seorang wanita berambut cokelat bergaun korset gelap memegang teko, menyeringai di tangga yang remang-remang.

3c9c0064c018.en: “Ahh. I think the sausage. It was really good, but the meat was good too. Did you prepare it with mushrooms?” Harry pointed at the mostly empty plate right by the mess of rakujas left by Nina.
3c9c0064c018.t: “Ahh. Kurasa sosisnya. Enak sekali, tapi dagingnya juga enak. Apa kalian memasaknya dengan jamur?” Harry menunjuk piring yang hampir kosong tepat di samping kekacauan rakuja yang ditinggalkan Nina.

3eb7ed866c80.en: Harry could feel her breath, her warmth, and the softness of her breasts still teasing him to no end. Unable to muster a complete sentence, all he could do was to mumble “Yeah—”
3eb7ed866c80.t: Harry bisa merasakan napasnya, kehangatannya, dan kelembutan payudaranya yang masih terus menggodanya tanpa henti. Tidak mampu menyusun kalimat yang utuh, yang bisa ia lakukan hanyalah bergumam, “Iya—”

3f9cfa1b355e.en: Itagiba whispered, or rather tried to whisper, but he was still quite loud. Saliva flew towards Harry’s ear, landing on his cheeks, “Don’t worry, bud! Hic—tonight I will try again! If a son comes out, I will make sure you will have the first dibs when he’s ready!” Itagiba mischievous snarked, then slapped Harry’s back three times, quite hard, appearing to save Harry from a non-existent choking hazard.
3f9cfa1b355e.t: Itagiba berbisik, atau lebih tepatnya mencoba berbisik, tetapi masih cukup keras. Ludah melayang ke telinga Harry, mendarat di pipinya, “Jangan khawatir, Bro! Hik—malam ini aku akan mencoba lagi! Kalau yang keluar putra, akan kupastikan kau dapat giliran pertama kalau dia sudah siap!” Itagiba menyeringai nakal, lalu menepuk punggung Harry tiga kali, cukup keras, tampak seolah menyelamatkan Harry dari bahaya tersedak yang tidak ada.

3fffac2c40bd.en: Neferteri was about to speak when a wet gurgle came from Itagiba, accompanied by an audible clap of a wooden mug hitting the table “It’s easy, bud! Hic! You sign the contract, and will duel Maiara tomorrow. If you win, you get her hand, and a life of riches—arrggghhh.” A wet burp came out of him. He held his mouth with a fist while the other hand gave a wait signal. A few seconds later, he followed up “—but if you lose, you will work for us.” Itagiba drunkenly opened his hands wide and far from his body. “I—mean—C’MON. That’s a fucking win either way right there!” He grabbed his empty cup, and pointed at Harry. “Do you know how many people would be dying for this?”
3fffac2c40bd.t: Neferteri hendak berbicara ketika deguk basah keluar dari Itagiba, disertai bunyi tepuk keras gelas kayu yang menghantam meja. “Gampang, Bro! Hik! Kau tanda tangani kontraknya, dan berduel dengan Maiara besok. Kalau kau menang, kau dapat tangannya, dan hidup bergelimang harta—arrggghhh.” Sendawa basah keluar darinya. Ia menutup mulutnya dengan kepalan tangan sementara tangan yang lain memberi isyarat tunggu. Beberapa detik kemudian, ia melanjutkan, “—tapi kalau kau kalah, kau bekerja untuk kami.” Itagiba dengan mabuk merentangkan tangannya lebar-lebar menjauhi tubuhnya. “Maksud—ku—AYOLAH. Itu menang besar, bangsat, yang mana pun hasilnya!” Ia meraih gelasnya yang kosong, dan menunjuk Harry. “Kau tahu berapa banyak orang yang rela mati demi ini?”

40002e2ccde2.en: “Motherfucker!” In the struggle, Maiara managed to grab a rakuja, then stood up and quickly threw it like a professional pitcher—arching her arm, and all—against Eori’s head right as she was about to enjoyingly take another bite.
40002e2ccde2.t: “Bangsat!” Di tengah perebutan, Maiara berhasil meraih satu rakuja, lalu berdiri dan cepat-cepat melemparnya seperti pelempar bisbol profesional—lengkap dengan lengan yang melengkung dan semuanya—ke kepala Eori tepat saat ia hendak menikmati gigitan berikutnya.

40968cbe98f8.en: “That’s what you get!” A low, but audible girly voice came from the corner end of the table, from a princess in purple hair called Eori, right as she took another bite of a decently sized chunk of coal-grilled fish.
40968cbe98f8.t: “Rasain!” Suara feminin yang pelan, tetapi terdengar, datang dari ujung sudut meja, dari seorang putri berambut ungu bernama Eori, tepat saat ia menggigit lagi sepotong ikan bakar arang yang cukup besar.

4124dd0fd228.en: “Whenever the nari gel is finished.” Neferteri opened her hand, and received the contract from Eiri, then displayed it towards Harry. “My husband, even with his savory choice of words, did correctly summarize it.” She shone the faintest smile in the corner of her mouth towards Eiri “—Is there anything else you would like to add?”
4124dd0fd228.t: “Kapan pun nari gel-nya selesai.” Neferteri membuka tangannya, dan menerima kontrak itu dari Eiri, lalu memperlihatkannya kepada Harry. “Suami saya, bahkan dengan pilihan katanya yang sedap itu, telah meringkasnya dengan benar.” Ia memancarkan senyum paling samar di sudut mulutnya ke arah Eiri, “—Apakah ada hal lain yang ingin kamu tambahkan?”

444c65a4dd33.en: “Yes, king-maid.” The tall maid with long black hair and freckles by the name of Itanema grabbed the wet towels from a nearby basket, approached Harry, and handed it to him in a shoving motion.
444c65a4dd33.t: “Baik, king-maid.” Pelayan jangkung berambut hitam panjang dan berbintik-bintik bernama Itanema mengambil handuk basah dari keranjang di dekatnya, mendekati Harry, dan menyerahkannya dengan gerakan menyodorkan.

46c897b14047.en: “I’m Arukia—” Arukia smiled, interrupting herself mid-sentence. “—and I’ve been told you're Harry Sanbi, right?”
46c897b14047.t: “Aku Arukia—” Arukia tersenyum, memotong kalimatnya sendiri. “—dan katanya kau Harry Sanbi, kan?”

479d7d2b49fa.en: Okay? Harry chowed down the bagel quickly, and did as told.
479d7d2b49fa.t: Oke? Harry melahap bagel itu dengan cepat, dan melakukan apa yang disuruh.

4a18f56bf39e.en: Picking at the food on his plate, Harry brought a piece of a purple meat sausage to his mouth. There was a burst of chicken flavor, specifically from dark meat mixed with bone marrow. The fat within the sausage balanced the other spices out to create this smooth meaty goodness palate. Kinda tastes like chicken, but there is something different. Was it always purple? Hmmm—what about this? Kinda tastes a bit gamey—a little tough too. Oh? Is that mushroom? Harry picked at another meat that looked like corned brisket. He smelled it, then took another bite. It is definitely kinda salty, a bit peppery too—but is the mushroom smell from the meat itself? Hmmm. Never had this before. Would be nice inside a taco—
4a18f56bf39e.t: Mencomot makanan di piringnya, Harry memasukkan sepotong sosis daging ungu ke mulutnya. Ada ledakan rasa ayam, khususnya dari daging paha bercampur sumsum tulang. Lemak di dalam sosis itu menyeimbangkan bumbu-bumbu lainnya hingga menciptakan cita rasa daging yang lembut dan nikmat. Rasanya agak seperti ayam, tapi ada yang berbeda. Apa dari dulu warnanya ungu? Hmmm—kalau yang ini? Rasanya agak prengus—agak alot juga. Oh? Apa itu jamur? Harry mencomot daging lain yang tampak seperti sandung lamur kornet. Ia menciumnya, lalu menggigitnya lagi. Jelas agak asin, agak pedas merica juga—tapi apa bau jamurnya dari dagingnya sendiri? Hmmm. Belum pernah makan ini. Pasti enak di dalam taco—

4a83758199a9.en: With a sudden thirst for blood, Maiara’s hands searched the table for something, stopping to focus on the Rakujas.
4a83758199a9.t: Dengan haus darah yang tiba-tiba, tangan Maiara mencari-cari sesuatu di meja, berhenti dan terpusat pada Rakuja-rakuja itu.

4b42bdb44c14.en: “Itanema!” Arukia angrily tried to call the maid at the door, but it was too late. She already closed it without giving a chance for rebuttal.
4b42bdb44c14.t: “Itanema!” Arukia dengan marah mencoba memanggil pelayan di pintu itu, tetapi sudah terlambat. Ia sudah menutupnya tanpa memberi kesempatan untuk membantah.

4cb40f1ff415.en: The maid grabbed an open book from atop the couch, and sat in its place with no finesse, or femininity, at all. Adjusting her hair, she crossed her legs, locking away her jewel box from potential prying male fingers and eyes.
4cb40f1ff415.t: Pelayan itu mengambil sebuah buku yang terbuka dari atas sofa, dan duduk di tempatnya tanpa keanggunan, atau kefemininan, sama sekali. Merapikan rambutnya, ia menyilangkan kakinya, mengunci kotak perhiasannya dari jari-jari dan mata lelaki yang mungkin ingin mengintip.

4cf49203bba0.en: Neferteri, the queen, beside Itagiba, lost her elegant smile and restful expression. In its place, arose a stare like daggers against Nina. “No more rakujas until next Sannday.”
4cf49203bba0.t: Neferteri, sang ratu, di samping Itagiba, kehilangan senyum anggun dan raut tenangnya. Sebagai gantinya, muncul tatapan setajam belati ke arah Nina. “Tidak ada rakuja lagi sampai Sannday berikutnya.”

4e215938a4eb.en: “What? I didn’t say anything!” Eori took another bite of her food, and lifted a towel to hide her mouth—trying to hide a wide grin based on the wrinkle in her eyes.
4e215938a4eb.t: “Apa? Aku tidak bilang apa-apa!” Eori menggigit lagi makanannya, dan mengangkat handuk untuk menyembunyikan mulutnya—berusaha menyembunyikan senyum lebar, kalau dilihat dari kerutan di matanya.

4f8d812bf6e3.en: Placing her open hand towards the contract, Neferteri broke the silence. “I will give you until Monnahigh to consider this proposition. If you do not wish to sign, then the guards will escort you back to the slums. King-maid?” Her voice was just as strong-willed, but far more stern than her husband’s.
4f8d812bf6e3.t: Meletakkan tangannya yang terbuka ke arah kontrak, Neferteri memecah keheningan. “Saya akan memberi Anda waktu sampai Monnahigh untuk mempertimbangkan tawaran ini. Jika Anda tidak ingin menandatanganinya, maka para pengawal akan mengantar Anda kembali ke permukiman kumuh. King-maid?” Suaranya sama berkemauan kerasnya, tetapi jauh lebih tegas daripada suaminya.

50778a550538.en: Still having no words, Harry cleaned Itagiba’s saliva from his ear as he saw the king happily stumble his way out of the room.
50778a550538.t: Masih tanpa kata, Harry membersihkan ludah Itagiba dari telinganya sambil melihat sang raja dengan gembira terhuyung-huyung keluar ruangan.

553cc4877ed8.en: Standing up as well, Harry felt an idea snap through his brain “Wait. Why can’t I take the contract with me to my room?”
553cc4877ed8.t: Ikut berdiri, Harry merasakan sebuah ide melintas di otaknya, “Tunggu. Kenapa aku tidak boleh membawa kontraknya ke kamarku?”

55cbdce0cf31.en: “Shesh—I didn’t tell you to gulp it down.” The maid took Harry’s empty cup.
55cbdce0cf31.t: “Ampun deh—aku tidak menyuruhmu menenggaknya.” Pelayan itu mengambil cangkir kosong Harry.

56d45e39e44e.en: A tall maid with black hair and freckles opened a sliver of the door. “Harry—oh Arukia. Since you’re here glued to him, clean it up, and bring him down for dinner.” Her monotone voice sounded like it was her final words. “—Unless you want Maiara to find out.”
56d45e39e44e.t: Seorang pelayan jangkung berambut hitam dan berbintik-bintik membuka sedikit celah pintu. “Harry—oh, Arukia. Karena kau di sini menempel padanya, bereskan semuanya, dan bawa dia turun untuk makan malam.” Suaranya yang monoton terdengar seperti kata-kata terakhirnya. “—Kecuali kau mau Maiara tahu.”

594df77f5f5c.en: Neferteri brought out her badge, and handed it over to Eiri. Eiri, in turn, placed the badge on top of the splattered blood, making the base of the thermometer-like apparatus, where one would put his or her thumb, faintly glow.
594df77f5f5c.t: Neferteri mengeluarkan lencananya, dan menyerahkannya kepada Eiri. Eiri, pada gilirannya, meletakkan lencana itu di atas cipratan darah, membuat pangkal alat mirip termometer itu, tempat seseorang meletakkan jempolnya, menyala samar.

59ff13389195.en: “I visited the Forway castle once, nothing out of this world—it’s just a large black tower with a bunch of self-important people. But who cares about them?” The maid quickly flipped through several pages, stopping on a bird’s eye view of a specific map. “I'd rather know about my special guest!” The maid squished her breasts against Harry’s arm, placing the open book in his lap.
59ff13389195.t: “Aku pernah mengunjungi kastil Forway sekali, tidak ada yang luar biasa—cuma menara hitam besar dengan segerombolan orang yang merasa diri penting. Tapi siapa peduli dengan mereka?” Pelayan itu cepat-cepat membalik beberapa halaman, berhenti di peta tertentu dari sudut pandang mata burung. “Aku lebih ingin tahu tentang tamu istimewaku!” Pelayan itu menekankan payudaranya ke lengan Harry, meletakkan buku yang terbuka di pangkuannya.

5ab2759d9b43.en: “You think? That’s—” A snappy, yet girly response ensued, but Arukia seemed to catch herself with a breath. Changing back to a more persuasive tone, she continued. “Is that because Nina gave you that name?”
5ab2759d9b43.t: “Kurasa? Itu—” Jawaban yang ketus, namun feminin, menyusul, tetapi Arukia tampaknya menahan dirinya dengan satu tarikan napas. Kembali ke nada yang lebih membujuk, ia melanjutkan. “Apa itu karena Nina yang memberimu nama itu?”

5cf340fcd1b8.en: “We will talk later. Now apologize to him, and clean your hands.” Neferteri took a small bite of her food.
5cf340fcd1b8.t: “Kita bicarakan nanti. Sekarang minta maaf kepadanya, dan bersihkan tanganmu.” Neferteri menggigit sedikit makanannya.

5ea8e2a4ca8b.en: The sound of Nefeteri’s footing echoed in the dining hall, while Harry and Eiri stood in silence, looking at one another.
5ea8e2a4ca8b.t: Bunyi langkah kaki Nefeteri menggema di ruang makan, sementara Harry dan Eiri berdiri dalam diam, saling memandang.

60bc79b4d68f.en: “Thank you, princess Nina—” The queen took a small glance at Harry and Nina as the elegance of her expression remained.
60bc79b4d68f.t: “Terima kasih, putri Nina—” Sang ratu melirik sekilas Harry dan Nina sementara keanggunan raut wajahnya tetap terjaga.

622e677c9eca.en: “HARRY! RAKUJA!” A sweet, energetic child’s voice echoed above the normal murmurs at the dinner table.
622e677c9eca.t: “HARRY! RAKUJA!” Suara anak kecil yang manis dan enerjik menggema melampaui gumaman biasa di meja makan.

626b830bde1d.en: Removing the picker with a swift pull, Maiara responded to Itagiba by throwing it on the table towards Nina. With her arm now bleeding profusely from what appeared to be a snake bite, she stained her own clothes, and the floor, as she took out a small sack from inside her leather garment, and threw it across the table, right on Nina’s rakuja plate, making a metallic, rocky sound as it struck. “Take your fucking rakujas then—” Maiara made her way out of the dining room, stomping out as she held her profusely bleeding arm, leaving a trail of dripped blood in the floor.
626b830bde1d.t: Mencabut picker itu dengan tarikan cepat, Maiara menjawab Itagiba dengan melemparnya ke meja ke arah Nina. Dengan lengannya kini berdarah deras dari luka yang tampak seperti gigitan ular, ia menodai pakaiannya sendiri, dan lantai, saat ia mengeluarkan kantong kecil dari dalam pakaian kulitnya, dan melemparnya ke seberang meja, tepat ke piring rakuja Nina, menimbulkan bunyi logam berbatu saat menghantam. “Ambil rakuja sialanmu itu—” Maiara keluar dari ruang makan, mengentak-entakkan kaki sambil memegangi lengannya yang berdarah deras, meninggalkan jejak tetesan darah di lantai.

627cd84d66d4.en: Harry saw a plethora of purple meat fibers stuck in the teeth of this towering man. Next, a strong beer breath came out as he further approached, looking as if the king was about to kiss him on the cheeks. Harry stood there, still paralyzed, with a shock to his face as if he was about to be shot. Meanwhile, his hands clenched tightly against his body, failing to even try to defend himself.
627cd84d66d4.t: Harry melihat banyak serat daging ungu yang terselip di gigi pria jangkung ini. Berikutnya, napas bir yang kuat keluar saat ia semakin mendekat, tampak seolah sang raja akan mencium pipinya. Harry diam di sana, masih lumpuh, dengan raut terkejut di wajahnya seolah akan ditembak. Sementara itu, tangannya terkepal erat di dekat tubuhnya, bahkan tidak mencoba membela diri.

63d0361c48d8.en: Itagiba, the king dressed in gold with blue fish scales, belly laughed, but quickly choked on his half eaten meat, and had to resort to gulping it down with beer.
63d0361c48d8.t: Itagiba, sang raja yang berpakaian emas dengan sisik ikan biru, tertawa terbahak-bahak, tetapi cepat tersedak daging yang baru setengah dimakan, dan terpaksa menelannya dengan bir.

67c055b25c9d.en: “I’m sorry, Harry. You need to make the call, not me—that’s all I can do right now. If you really want to read it, then go across the hall and knock on the monarchy department. That’s where Neferteri probably went, but be wary of her—” With an anguished look, Eiri moved her hand towards the door, telling Harry to move on.
67c055b25c9d.t: “Maaf, Harry. Kamu yang harus memutuskan, bukan aku—hanya itu yang bisa kulakukan sekarang. Kalau kamu benar-benar ingin membacanya, seberangi aula dan ketuk pintu departemen monarki. Mungkin Neferteri pergi ke sana, tapi berhati-hatilah dengannya—” Dengan raut tersiksa, Eiri menggerakkan tangannya ke arah pintu, menyuruh Harry untuk pergi.

6c3a94bccec7.en: With his elbows on the table, Harry slowly rubbed one palm on the back of the other hand, looking back at the contract, “Thank you—it’s just that I—need some time. I want to read it carefully, but—”
6c3a94bccec7.t: Dengan siku di atas meja, Harry perlahan menggosokkan satu telapak tangan ke punggung tangan yang lain, kembali memandang kontrak itu, “Terima kasih—hanya saja aku—butuh waktu. Aku ingin membacanya dengan teliti, tapi—”

6cd859eaefe5.en: “Don’t give me that look!” The maid snapped at Harry, taking a shallow sip of her own tea, somehow enjoying its complex flavors.
6cd859eaefe5.t: “Jangan pasang tampang begitu padaku!” Pelayan itu membentak Harry, menyesap tehnya sendiri sedikit, entah bagaimana menikmati rasanya yang kompleks.

72334f4ab7f7.en: “Ahhh—no?” Harry felt his heart rate pound on the back of his throat. Moving his hand close to his body, Harry held them tightly, away from the towering drunk king on the other side of the table.
72334f4ab7f7.t: “Ahhh—bukan?” Harry merasakan detak jantungnya berdebam di belakang tenggorokannya. Menarik tangannya dekat ke tubuhnya, Harry memegangnya erat-erat, menjauh dari raja mabuk yang menjulang di sisi lain meja.

Rambut ungu tua panjangnya dengan helai-helai biru, diikat menjadi kuncir kuda besar, diikat dengan ikat rambut kupu-kupu merah dan merah muda. Mata ungunya yang lembut dan kulitnya yang cerah membuatnya cantik dipandang, tetapi dengan beberapa kedipan lagi orang bisa melihat jejak-jejak jelas ciri Itagiba, terutama saat ia mulai bicara.

For that, I’ve requested a nari gel from Princess Eori—for she can make some gels just as good as veteran scientists. And do not worry, you do not need to partake in the contract for that benefit.” Neferteri made deep eye contact with Harry as the corners of her mouth formed a small smile. “Think of it as a token of our gratitude for indulging in our request. As soon as it is ready, a maid will deliver it to your room.”
a71040062c66.t: “Saya mengerti posisi Anda. Sungguh,” Neferteri meletakkan tangannya di meja, menimbulkan bunyi denting lembut saat cincin-cincin emas logam di tangannya beradu dengan meja. “Kami menyadari bahwa Anda memiliki masalah penglihatan. Untuk itu, saya telah meminta sebuah nari gel dari Putri Eori—karena ia bisa membuat beberapa gel yang sama bagusnya dengan ilmuwan veteran. bc376937cd9c.en: The room, now with only a man and a woman was a true realm of possibilities—just like an amusement park, but more physically demanding. The maid’s smirk shone once again as her predator’s eyes saw her prey willingly make his way towards her, tensed up as if he was a male praying mantis mindlessly making a move to mate even though he knew the consequences thereafter.
bc376937cd9c.t: Ruangan itu, kini hanya berisi seorang pria dan seorang wanita, adalah benar-benar alam penuh kemungkinan—seperti taman hiburan, tetapi lebih menuntut fisik. Seringai pelayan itu bersinar sekali lagi saat mata pemangsanya melihat mangsanya dengan sukarela berjalan ke arahnya, tegang seolah ia belalang sembah jantan yang tanpa pikir panjang bergerak untuk kawin walaupun tahu akibatnya setelah itu.

bc7400de82ab.en: A small eerie silence claimed the room. Neferteri cleaned her throat as her head barely shook, subtly closing her eyes to go back to enjoy her wine.
bc7400de82ab.t: Keheningan kecil yang ganjil menguasai ruangan. Neferteri berdeham sementara kepalanya nyaris tak menggeleng, perlahan memejamkan matanya untuk kembali menikmati anggurnya.

bd7aa793e71c.en: Itagiba looked at her hand, his body shuffling away from her in what appeared to be an acute shoulder pinch, “Ohh—one of those nights! Sanbi shit!—Okay—okay! I’m going!” Itagiba placed down the empty glass jug, then his hand on the table as he walked around it, drunkenly making his way towards Harry. Almost falling on him as came closer, he then also propped himself on Harry’s chair, putting his face towards Harry's ear.
bd7aa793e71c.t: Itagiba memandang tangan istrinya, tubuhnya menggeliat menjauh darinya karena tampaknya cubitan bahu yang tajam, “Ohh—salah satu malam seperti itu! Demi jiwa tua Sanbi!—Oke—oke! Aku pergi!” Itagiba meletakkan kendi kaca yang kosong, lalu tangannya di meja sambil berjalan mengitarinya, dengan mabuk berjalan ke arah Harry. Hampir jatuh menimpanya saat mendekat, ia lalu juga bertumpu pada kursi Harry, mendekatkan wajahnya ke telinga Harry.

bde9b5b0b3a0.en: I guess I don’t. Harry felt those words sting him, as he watched Itagiba about to pour the rest of the beer from the jug into the pitcher, but then just throw the pitcher aside, and drink straight from the jug like a frat boy. Shifting his attention towards Eiri, he saw a tense smile shine on her face, but Harry could feel her eyes had much to say—but they weren’t saying anything, not even a hint. Looking at Sora, Harry only saw that she actively avoided making eye-contact with him, even as to turn her head away when Harry kept on looking. Do I just sign it? But Eiri told me to consider it carefully, but I can’t really understand it—why can’t she just help me? Harry glanced back at the king and queen, waiting for him to simply comply. His muscles were all tensed up, with a large frown mixed with a peaked eyebrow. He felt like he triggered a quick time event, but he didn’t know how long he had to act. His breath was somewhat deep, but his heart pulsated strongly on his chest. He wanted to say yes, but he just couldn’t bring himself to actually do it; such a simple word to say got wedged in his throat, refusing to get out.
bde9b5b0b3a0.t: Kurasa aku tidak tahu. Harry merasakan kata-kata itu menyengatnya, sambil memperhatikan Itagiba yang hendak menuang sisa bir dari kendi ke dalam gelas, tetapi malah melempar gelas itu ke samping, dan minum langsung dari kendi seperti anak frat. Mengalihkan perhatiannya ke Eiri, ia melihat senyum tegang bersinar di wajahnya, tetapi Harry bisa merasakan mata Eiri punya banyak hal untuk dikatakan—tetapi mata itu tidak mengatakan apa pun, bahkan tidak memberi petunjuk. Memandang Sora, Harry hanya melihat bahwa ia dengan sengaja menghindari kontak mata dengannya, bahkan sampai memalingkan kepalanya ketika Harry terus memandang. Apa aku tanda tangani saja? Tapi Eiri menyuruhku mempertimbangkannya baik-baik, tapi aku tidak benar-benar memahaminya—kenapa dia tidak membantuku saja? Harry kembali melirik sang raja dan ratu, yang menunggunya untuk sekadar menurut. Otot-ototnya semua menegang, dengan kerutan dahi yang besar bercampur alis yang terangkat. Ia merasa seperti memicu quick time event, tetapi ia tidak tahu berapa lama waktu yang ia punya untuk bertindak. Napasnya agak dalam, tetapi jantungnya berdenyut kuat di dadanya. Ia ingin berkata ya, tetapi ia tidak bisa membuat dirinya benar-benar melakukannya; kata yang begitu sederhana untuk diucapkan tersangkut di tenggorokannya, menolak keluar.

c0283aa19972.en: Chapter IV subchapter 2: a long dining hall with a fish-painted ceiling, many people seated at a red-clothed table.
c0283aa19972.t: Bab IV subbab 2: ruang makan panjang dengan langit-langit bergambar ikan, banyak orang duduk di meja berkain merah.

c0c57af231c9.en: Harry, with pink cream cheese and breadcrumbs on the sides of his mouth, chowed down the last piece of his filling bagel, and accepted Arukia’s.
c0c57af231c9.t: Harry, dengan krim keju merah muda dan remah roti di sudut-sudut mulutnya, melahap potongan terakhir bagelnya yang mengenyangkan, dan menerima bagel Arukia.

c17a8c0488f2.en: A groan came out of Harry, still trying to clean away the juices. In his blurry vision, he saw the two maids at the end of the table. Sora looked like she just had seen an accident, and was moments away from sprinting to help, while the other maid stood up as if nothing had happened.
c17a8c0488f2.t: Erangan keluar dari Harry, yang masih berusaha membersihkan sari buah itu. Dalam penglihatannya yang buram, ia melihat dua pelayan di ujung meja. Sora tampak seperti baru melihat kecelakaan, dan tinggal sesaat lagi akan berlari untuk menolong, sementara pelayan yang lain berdiri seolah tidak terjadi apa-apa.

c1ef224e56f1.en: Arukia stood up. “I figured—even her food is bland. Now help me clean this up!” she pointed at the coffee table “I’m going to go get the fost lamp up instead!”
c1ef224e56f1.t: Arukia berdiri. “Sudah kuduga—bahkan makanannya pun hambar. Sekarang bantu aku membereskan ini!” ia menunjuk meja kopi, “Aku mau menyalakan lampu fost saja!”

c3171b31d6ba.en: Harry looked towards the source of the voice, Nina, but all he saw was ball-shaped fruit flying towards his face, right before it squashed itself like an egg being dropped onto the floor. The fruit exploded on him, revealing black seeds wrapped in a sack of yellow, slightly tangy and sweet juice. Gravity then finished the job by pulling it down towards his nose, before it slumped on his belly, landing on his lap.
c3171b31d6ba.t: Harry memandang ke arah sumber suara itu, Nina, tetapi yang ia lihat hanyalah buah berbentuk bola yang melayang ke arah wajahnya, tepat sebelum buah itu remuk seperti telur yang dijatuhkan ke lantai. Buah itu meledak di wajahnya, memperlihatkan biji-biji hitam yang terbungkus kantong sari buah kuning yang agak asam dan manis. Gravitasi lalu menyelesaikan tugasnya dengan menariknya turun ke hidungnya, sebelum buah itu merosot ke perutnya, mendarat di pangkuannya.

c3a9274f7072.en: “That’s—different. Hurgh,” Itagiba looked more confused than before, burping a bit loudly before downing another pitch of beer, perhaps trying to make sense of what just came out of Harry’s mouth.
c3a9274f7072.t: “Itu—lain dari yang lain. Hurgh,” Itagiba tampak lebih bingung dari sebelumnya, bersendawa agak keras sebelum menenggak segelas bir lagi, mungkin mencoba memahami apa yang baru saja keluar dari mulut Harry.

c3b504d9fffa.en: Meanwhile, the person beside Harry, a tall girl with a ponytail that kinda looked like Itagiba, but more female, let out a disappointed “Pffft.”
c3b504d9fffa.t: Sementara itu, orang di samping Harry, seorang gadis jangkung berkuncir kuda yang agak mirip Itagiba, tetapi lebih feminin, mengeluarkan “Pffft” yang kecewa.

c4cf84f5ccd0.en: With all the maids gone, except for Sora, Eiri picked up a scroll from a red with golden accents couch that fit four people, and unrolled it in front of Harry. It was a fancy glossy paper, with a highly detailed blue border that made the handwritten wall of text in red fancier, albeit contrasting what appeared to be blood spatter mixed with a translucent grain in the bottom left; the bottom right looked eerily spotless though.
c4cf84f5ccd0.t: Dengan semua pelayan sudah pergi, kecuali Sora, Eiri mengambil sebuah gulungan dari sofa merah beraksen emas yang muat empat orang, dan membukanya di depan Harry. Kertasnya mewah dan mengilap, dengan bingkai biru yang sangat detail yang membuat dinding teks tulisan tangan berwarna merah tampak lebih mewah, meski kontras dengan sesuatu yang tampak seperti cipratan darah bercampur butiran tembus pandang di kiri bawah; kanan bawahnya tampak bersih tanpa noda secara ganjil.

c73029518e36.en: “Then I shall confirm with Princess Eori. I appreciate you indulging us thus far.” Neferteri excused herself as well.
c73029518e36.t: “Kalau begitu saya akan memastikan dengan Putri Eori. Saya menghargai kesediaan Anda sejauh ini.” Neferteri juga pamit.

c8017dd72e60.en: “I’m sorry!” Nina, the small child in pink, caught his attention away from the conversation. Her teary eyes looked back and forth between Harry and her mother, the queen. She grabbed a picker with each hand, eagerly awaiting what was gonna come next from her mother, Neferteri.
c8017dd72e60.t: “Maaf!” Nina, anak kecil berbaju merah muda, menarik perhatiannya dari percakapan itu. Matanya yang berlinang memandang bolak-balik antara Harry dan ibunya, sang ratu. Ia memegang satu picker di masing-masing tangan, menunggu dengan cemas apa yang akan dikatakan ibunya, Neferteri, selanjutnya.

c8ea9f67f13b.en: Maiara sulked as her purple eyes stared back at Neferteri’s, enjoying her wine. “You want an introduction? Okay.” The sulk in her lips transformed into a sure Itagiba-like smirk, her eyes now impishly glared towards Harry’s, appreciating his apparent immeasurable sex appeal: his faint neckbeard, barely visible mustache complemented the unconfident look in his face. His large gut, nearly exploding out of his shirt, drew enough attention to itself, but then there was the exposed hairy belly button also fighting for attention. Finally, the wet towel with yellow stains and black seeds resting on his lap showing a bulge in his tight pants was the final touch in creating this vision of a dream man—for someone, maybe a very specific individual somewhere in the four corners of the world.
c8ea9f67f13b.t: Maiara merajuk sementara mata ungunya balas menatap mata Neferteri, yang sedang menikmati anggurnya. “Mau perkenalan? Oke.” Rajukan di bibirnya berubah menjadi seringai yakin ala Itagiba, matanya kini menatap nakal ke mata Harry, menghargai daya tarik seksnya yang tampaknya tak terukur: janggut leher tipisnya, kumis yang nyaris tak terlihat melengkapi raut tidak percaya diri di wajahnya. Perutnya yang besar, nyaris meledak keluar dari kemejanya, cukup menarik perhatian, tetapi masih ada pusar berbulu yang terbuka yang juga berebut perhatian. Akhirnya, handuk basah dengan noda kuning dan biji-biji hitam yang terletak di pangkuannya yang memperlihatkan tonjolan di celananya yang ketat adalah sentuhan terakhir dalam menciptakan gambaran pria idaman ini—bagi seseorang, mungkin individu yang sangat spesifik di suatu tempat di empat penjuru dunia.

c9b45f1729fb.en: With his internal intuition screaming at him—or maybe it was just a shot of adrenaline that sped up his heartbeat, Harry looked to the spiraling stairs, devoid of life, then back at her seductive red lips. Do it! Do it! An even higher voice inside him told to be a man. His mind, racing with possibilities, followed after this maid’s request, and saw the stairs disappear behind the door closing, by his own eager, but skittish hand.
c9b45f1729fb.t: Dengan intuisi batinnya yang menjerit kepadanya—atau mungkin itu hanya suntikan adrenalin yang mempercepat detak jantungnya, Harry memandang tangga spiral, yang kosong tanpa kehidupan, lalu kembali ke bibir merahnya yang menggoda. Lakukan! Lakukan! Suara yang lebih tinggi lagi di dalam dirinya menyuruhnya untuk jadi laki-laki. Pikirannya, yang berpacu dengan berbagai kemungkinan, mengikuti permintaan pelayan ini, dan melihat tangga itu menghilang di balik pintu yang ditutup oleh tangannya sendiri yang bersemangat, tetapi gugup.

cac96802482b.en: Eiri whistled twice, and soon after a gleeful older lady with thicker proportions, and well-endowed breasts—which she was not afraid to show off—appeared. She also wore the usual black and blue maid clothing, but she also had a red thatch hat, and caramel-colored short hair. She extended her empty hand towards Harry while carrying a large bucket with the other. “Need another towel, honey?”
cac96802482b.t: Eiri bersiul dua kali, dan tak lama kemudian muncul seorang wanita yang lebih tua dan riang, dengan proporsi tubuh yang lebih berisi, dan payudara yang montok—yang tidak segan ia pamerkan. Ia juga mengenakan pakaian pelayan hitam dan biru seperti biasa, tetapi ia juga memakai topi jerami merah, dan berambut pendek berwarna karamel. Ia mengulurkan tangannya yang kosong ke arah Harry sambil membawa ember besar dengan tangan yang lain. “Perlu handuk lagi, sayang?”

caffd748da8c.en: So nobody knows about that after all? With an estranged smile, Harry felt something odd with the tea—maybe the strong smell akin to air fresheners was to blame, but as he watched Arukia take a sip, he followed along; his palate first noticed the chunkiness of the tea—like drinking poorly mixed chocolate syrup and milk, followed by a diabetic knockout punch on his tongue, throat, and stomach. The aftertaste felt like a slap in the face by a citrusy flavor that was close to chewing on multiple fresh orange crusts. Harry soured his face, waiting for his stomach to survive the storm, teetering on the edge of transforming his esophagus into a hose, and destroying any goodwill he had for daring to drink the tea in the first place.
caffd748da8c.t: Jadi memang tidak ada yang tahu soal itu? Dengan senyum canggung, Harry merasakan ada yang aneh dengan teh itu—mungkin bau kuat yang mirip pengharum ruangan itulah penyebabnya, tetapi saat ia melihat Arukia menyesap, ia ikut menyesap; langit-langit mulutnya pertama-tama merasakan teh yang bergumpal—seperti meminum sirup cokelat dan susu yang tidak tercampur rata, disusul pukulan KO yang bikin diabetes di lidah, tenggorokan, dan perutnya. Sisa rasanya terasa seperti tamparan di wajah oleh rasa jeruk yang mirip mengunyah banyak kulit jeruk segar. Harry mengernyitkan wajahnya, menunggu perutnya selamat dari badai, berada di ambang mengubah kerongkongannya menjadi selang, dan menghancurkan niat baik apa pun yang ia miliki karena berani meminum teh itu sejak awal.

cc54bfb3fa3b.en: “Apologies for my husband, as he overindulges on occasion.” Neferteri, standing behind her own chair, gripped the top as if she was about to snap a piece right off, yet her expression remained just as peaceful, and elegant as one would expect.
cc54bfb3fa3b.t: “Mohon maaf atas suami saya, karena sesekali ia berlebihan.” Neferteri, berdiri di belakang kursinya sendiri, mencengkeram bagian atasnya seolah akan mematahkan sepotong, namun raut wajahnya tetap damai, dan anggun seperti yang diharapkan.

ced698c0d057.en: “Sorry for what? It’s his fault for being a fat pussy!” A womanly voice, sounding like a female version of Itagiba, spoke loudly in the room, tearing through all the ongoing conversations.
ced698c0d057.t: “Minta maaf buat apa? Salahnya sendiri jadi banci gendut!” Suara wanita, yang terdengar seperti Itagiba versi perempuan, berbicara keras di ruangan itu, merobek semua percakapan yang sedang berlangsung.

cf07c0a98d4c.en: Harry’s eyes were treated to eye candy from yet another maid. Her unnaturally bright cyan eyes and red lips were unavoidable to look at.
cf07c0a98d4c.t: Mata Harry dimanjakan pemandangan indah dari seorang pelayan lagi. Mata sian cerahnya yang tidak wajar dan bibir merahnya mustahil untuk tidak dipandangi.

d01ab7d30e7f.en: Itagiba shooed Neferteri’s hand away. “Nah—I’m fine. It’s my fault I did not have a cute son for Harry. I FUCKING TRIED, ALL RIGHT?” Itagiba cleaned away a manly tear running down his cheek.
d01ab7d30e7f.t: Itagiba menepis tangan Neferteri. “Nggak—aku baik-baik saja. Salahku sendiri tidak punya putra yang imut untuk Harry. AKU SUDAH BERUSAHA, BANGSAT, OKE?” Itagiba menyeka air mata jantan yang mengalir di pipinya.

d135b8265de8.en: Taking a sip of her wine, Neferteri, spoke softly. “Bathe her first.''
d135b8265de8.t: Sambil menyesap anggurnya, Neferteri berbicara pelan. “Mandikan dia dulu.''

d3a6ed5a2d7b.en: Neferteri stood up, closing her eyes tightly, taking a deep breath, as the rest of her body remained elegant and courteous. “Dear—you had too much to drink.”
d3a6ed5a2d7b.t: Neferteri berdiri, memejamkan matanya rapat-rapat, menarik napas dalam-dalam, sementara sisa tubuhnya tetap anggun dan sopan. “Sayang—kamu sudah terlalu banyak minum.”

d3d3e65fc64e.en: “MY RAKUJA! AHHHH!” Nina exclaimed with despair as Maiara chucked the remains of the rakuja right in front of her, making a sloppy wet sound. She picked it up with teary eyes as if it were the remains of her own son. Lifting it off the table, the remains then broke in half, and splashed back on the table—Nina lost it, and started bawling like a little baby.
d3d3e65fc64e.t: “RAKUJAKU! AHHHH!” seru Nina dengan putus asa saat Maiara melempar sisa rakuja itu tepat di depannya, menimbulkan bunyi basah yang becek. Ia memungutnya dengan mata berlinang seolah itu jasad putranya sendiri. Mengangkatnya dari meja, sisa buah itu lalu terbelah dua, dan memercik kembali ke meja—Nina tak tahan lagi, dan mulai meraung seperti bayi kecil.

d551932bf60b.en: “Poor you—it must be tough dealing with a soul death.” The maid flipped a few more pages, looking for something specific: A house-sized red wooden statue of three corpulent ladies seated by one another in the middle of a roundabout, looking cheerful to passerby. They wore pink bikinis, except the middle one also had a pink hat with a bright reddish tree on it. Even though it was a statue, one could still feel a welcome warmth from them—like visiting grandma, and she tells you that your favorite dessert is ready for you in the kitchen. “This ring any bells?” Arukia tapped on the drawing of the sisters.
d551932bf60b.t: “Kasihan kau—pasti berat menghadapi kematian jiwa.” Pelayan itu membalik beberapa halaman lagi, mencari sesuatu yang spesifik: patung kayu merah seukuran rumah berupa tiga wanita gemuk yang duduk bersebelahan di tengah bundaran, tampak ceria kepada orang-orang yang lewat. Mereka mengenakan bikini merah muda, hanya saja yang di tengah juga memakai topi merah muda dengan pohon kemerahan yang cerah di atasnya. Walaupun itu patung, orang tetap bisa merasakan kehangatan yang menyambut dari mereka—seperti mengunjungi nenek, dan ia bilang makanan penutup favoritmu sudah siap untukmu di dapur. “Ada yang terasa familier?” Arukia mengetuk gambar para saudari itu.

d5d283491a96.en: Squinting towards the book, his eyes could make a bit of sense of what the map was, but it clearly looked foreigner to him. “I’m—I’m not sure—I didn’t know there were multiple of them.” With a heavy breath, Harry tried his best to look at the maid’s rather unnaturally bright cyan eyes, rather than her breasts, but there’s only so much willpower a man could muster before his soul caved in.
d5d283491a96.t: Menyipitkan mata ke arah buku, matanya bisa sedikit memahami peta itu, tetapi jelas tampak asing baginya. “Aku—aku tidak yakin—aku tidak tahu ada lebih dari satu.” Dengan napas berat, Harry berusaha sebaik mungkin memandang mata sian pelayan itu yang cerahnya agak tidak wajar, alih-alih payudaranya, tetapi tekad seorang pria ada batasnya sebelum jiwanya runtuh.

dcd0d53065d3.en: “I’m good, thank you.” Harry slightly smiled back, imagining Nina stabbing his arm if he dared to take one. Plus, his belly felt full to the brim from two dinners in a row—he couldn’t help himself to a few more bagels.
dcd0d53065d3.t: “Aku sudah cukup, terima kasih.” Harry tersenyum tipis, membayangkan Nina menusuk lengannya kalau ia berani mengambil satu. Lagi pula, perutnya terasa penuh sampai ke ujung setelah dua kali makan malam berturut-turut—ia tidak bisa menahan diri untuk makan beberapa bagel lagi.

dd36c19d6861.en: “Argh. Whatever! How is this supposed to even help you?” She caught herself slipping again into a sharpened tongue. “—I knew you would be feeling meh after the resuscitation! Eiri told us all about it!”
dd36c19d6861.t: “Argh. Terserahlah! Bagaimana ini bisa membantumu?” Ia memergoki dirinya kembali kelepasan bicara tajam. “—Aku tahu kau bakal merasa lemas setelah resusitasi! Eiri sudah cerita semuanya kepada kami!”

defadf011c0b.en: The area surrounding Maiara became a splash zone of a theme park attraction; Harry and Kibe were the biggest casualties aside from Maiara's own hair and clothes.
defadf011c0b.t: Area di sekitar Maiara menjadi zona cipratan wahana taman hiburan; Harry dan Kibe adalah korban terbesar selain rambut dan pakaian Maiara sendiri.

dfbfd89ee893.en: “Where?” Harry widened eyes and suspenseful face accompanied his suddenly demanding tone.
dfbfd89ee893.t: “Di mana?” Mata Harry yang terbelalak dan wajahnya yang tegang menyertai nadanya yang tiba-tiba menuntut.

dfcf87bad162.en: Harry’s feet moved on their own, but instead of walking towards those doors, he walked downstairs, and out of the castle. In the courtyard, by the two doors he had just come out of, he saw two fost lamps. A bright light in the shape of a stone stood at the bottom of a glass container, emitting a bright white light. Around it, he could see bubbling around the stone constantly forming, releasing constant steam towards the surface. Those fost lamps are everywhere, but I never saw them before—or I guess I don’t remember them at all—but how would I forget something like that, but remember a bunch of weird crap?
dfcf87bad162.t: Kaki Harry bergerak sendiri, tetapi alih-alih berjalan ke arah pintu-pintu itu, ia berjalan turun, dan keluar dari kastil. Di halaman, di dekat dua pintu yang baru saja ia lewati, ia melihat dua lampu fost. Cahaya terang berbentuk batu berada di dasar wadah kaca, memancarkan cahaya putih yang terang. Di sekelilingnya, ia bisa melihat gelembung-gelembung di sekitar batu itu terus terbentuk, terus melepaskan uap ke permukaan. Lampu fost ini ada di mana-mana, tapi aku belum pernah melihatnya sebelumnya—atau mungkin aku saja yang sama sekali tidak ingat—tapi bagaimana mungkin aku melupakan hal seperti itu, tapi mengingat banyak hal aneh?

e0614288ac9b.en: Enjoyingly taking her time emptying the blue basket, her hands coincidentally became clumsy at one point, and she happened to drop an empty cup on the floor. Quickly picking it up, she arched her back along the way.
e0614288ac9b.t: Dengan senang hati berlama-lama mengosongkan keranjang biru itu, tangannya kebetulan menjadi canggung pada satu titik, dan ia kebetulan menjatuhkan cangkir kosong ke lantai. Cepat-cepat memungutnya, ia melengkungkan punggungnya di sepanjang gerakan itu.

e57d9cbeee2d.en: Maiara bent backwards on the table to take a good look at Princess Eori. “Bitch—what did you say?”
e57d9cbeee2d.t: Maiara mencondongkan tubuhnya ke belakang di meja untuk melihat baik-baik Putri Eori. “Jalang—kau bilang apa?”

e77a00d0be80.en: “Yeah— That’s my name—I think.” Harry felt like he wanted to get up, and get some fresh air. His adrenaline was like drinking five cups of coffee, and feeling an urge to walk about all day long.
e77a00d0be80.t: “Iya— Itu namaku—kurasa.” Harry merasa ingin berdiri, dan menghirup udara segar. Adrenalinnya seperti minum lima cangkir kopi, dan merasakan dorongan untuk berjalan-jalan seharian.

e9ac34e2d5e1.en: The fruit made a loud thud as it exploded on Eori’s soft, spotless cheek like a good punch. Eori’s body slumped to the empty seat beside her, giving Maiara a win by a technical knockout—at least for a few seconds before Eori wobblily sat back up, getting her bearings of where she was.
e9ac34e2d5e1.t: Buah itu berbunyi berdebum keras saat meledak di pipi Eori yang lembut dan mulus seperti pukulan telak. Tubuh Eori merosot ke kursi kosong di sampingnya, memberi Maiara kemenangan KO teknis—setidaknya selama beberapa detik sebelum Eori dengan sempoyongan duduk kembali, berusaha menyadari di mana dirinya berada.

ee10676061d7.en: “Urgh. That’s my backup uniform!” Kibe touched his uniform, stained all over with the yellow juice and seeds. He touched his hair next, and felt the same stickiness. With a grunt, he moved his chair back, and walked off mumbling to himself.
ee10676061d7.t: “Urgh. Itu seragam cadanganku!” Kibe menyentuh seragamnya, yang ternoda di mana-mana oleh sari buah kuning dan biji-biji. Ia lalu menyentuh rambutnya, dan merasakan lengket yang sama. Dengan erangan, ia memundurkan kursinya, dan pergi sambil menggerutu sendiri.

ee8f28c20d2a.en: “Are you a cartography buff?” The maid, curling up her hair with her finger, asked point blank, holding one of the half-turned pages as she glanced at Harry. One of the visible pages had a drawn picture of a large black castle with accents in red, blue, green, and yellow that poked the blue sky—at least that’s the feel it was given by whoever drew it from the ground angle.
ee8f28c20d2a.t: “Kau penggemar kartografi?” Pelayan itu, memilin rambutnya dengan jarinya, bertanya terus terang, memegang salah satu halaman yang setengah terbalik sambil melirik Harry. Salah satu halaman yang terlihat memuat gambar kastil hitam besar dengan aksen merah, biru, hijau, dan kuning yang menusuk langit biru—setidaknya begitulah kesan yang diberikan siapa pun yang menggambarnya dari sudut pandang tanah.

ef95b7531574.en: Itanema, the maid with long black hair and freckles, was now in the splash zone, as her upper uniform got soaked with juices. She looked at it, then ignored the griminess as if it wasn’t her first rodeo.
ef95b7531574.t: Itanema, pelayan berambut hitam panjang dan berbintik-bintik, kini berada di zona cipratan, karena seragam bagian atasnya basah kuyup oleh sari buah. Ia memandanginya, lalu mengabaikan kotornya seolah itu bukan pengalaman pertamanya.

efe1e68249ce.en: Feeling her breath and warmth encroaching him from the side, Harry snapped his neck towards her. “You—you know it as well?” His spirits seemed to have renewed itself, no longer paying as much attention to the pleasures of the flesh.
efe1e68249ce.t: Merasakan napas dan kehangatannya merangsek dari samping, Harry menoleh cepat ke arahnya. “Kau—kau juga tahu?” Semangatnya tampak bangkit kembali, tidak lagi terlalu memperhatikan kenikmatan daging.

f257a7055500.en: Eiri looked around the table, then towards Harry. Her lips formed an estranged smile, “Need anything else, Harry? We do have desserts too, even rakujas if you want to try them.” She looked at Nina’s unprotected plate, with some untouched rakujas.
f257a7055500.t: Eiri memandang sekeliling meja, lalu ke arah Harry. Bibirnya membentuk senyum canggung, “Butuh yang lain, Harry? Kami juga punya hidangan penutup, bahkan rakuja kalau kamu mau mencobanya.” Ia memandang piring Nina yang tak terlindungi, dengan beberapa rakuja yang belum tersentuh.

f29e7d235273.en: Meanwhile, Eiri, in a fancy maid dress sitting across from Harry, put down her beer pitcher. “You okay, Harry? Itanema, please get him two wet towels.”
f29e7d235273.t: Sementara itu, Eiri, dalam gaun pelayan mewah yang duduk di seberang Harry, meletakkan kendi birnya. “Kamu baik-baik saja, Harry? Itanema, tolong ambilkan dia dua handuk basah.”

f387bec0790f.en: Frozen, Harry speechlessly looked at the king of Sanbi kingdom, looking at him with flaring nostrils and bulging eyes.
f387bec0790f.t: Membeku, Harry tanpa kata memandang raja kerajaan Sanbi, yang memandangnya dengan lubang hidung mengembang dan mata melotot.

f55f2298813c.t: “Kau benar-benar suka itu? Iiih.” Arukia membersihkan bibirnya dengan handuk kecil dari kantong itu, kembali bersandar, dan memastikan ia menggeser tubuhnya sampai kulit menempel kulit dengan Harry.

f58d17d4a76f.en: With another “tsk,” Arukia peeked behind her, towards the window where the sun was quickly dying down, leaving orangish hard shadows throughout the room. Leaning forward, she placed down her cup and opened a bag of bagels.
f58d17d4a76f.t: Dengan “cih” lagi, Arukia menoleh ke belakang, ke arah jendela tempat matahari cepat meredup, meninggalkan bayangan keras kejinggaan di seluruh ruangan. Mencondongkan tubuh ke depan, ia meletakkan cangkirnya dan membuka sekantong bagel.

fab5ff2c19ea.en: “N–no.” Harry focused his attention on the book laying on her lap.
fab5ff2c19ea.t: “B–bukan.” Harry memusatkan perhatiannya pada buku yang tergeletak di pangkuannya.

fc19dbad4e38.en: Pausing his breath, Harry, still standing by the open door, focused his mind completely on acquiring the mental imagery of that “raw” instant. His mind went into imagination land, and he clearly saw himself closing the door, approaching her with full-handed butt slap, then sticking it into her right there and then until the sun went down. In reality, he stood by the open door, salivating at the thought as his hand gripped the handle.
fc19dbad4e38.t: Menahan napasnya, Harry, masih berdiri di dekat pintu yang terbuka, memusatkan pikirannya sepenuhnya untuk merekam gambaran mental dari momen “polos” itu. Pikirannya melayang ke negeri khayalan, dan ia jelas melihat dirinya menutup pintu, mendekatinya dengan tamparan telapak tangan penuh di bokongnya, lalu memasukkannya ke sana saat itu juga sampai matahari terbenam. Kenyataannya, ia berdiri di dekat pintu yang terbuka, ngiler membayangkannya sementara tangannya mencengkeram gagang pintu.
